variant_note: Dismounted squad of a Polish mechanised brigade (KTO Rosomak / BWP-1 carriers, e.g. 12th Mechanized Brigade), current kit: MSBS Grot C rifle, wz. 2005 helmet (HP-05 / HBT-02 being fielded), KKZ-01 plate carrier, wz. 93 Pantera uniform. Dimensions describe one soldier.

armament.main: MSBS Grot C 5.56 mm assault rifle (conventional layout; FB Beryl wz. 96C 5.56 mm still in service)
armament.secondary: UKM-2000 7.62 mm GPMG; Pallad / GPBO-40 40 mm underbarrel grenade launcher; RPG-7 (being replaced by Carl Gustaf M4 84 mm), M72 EC LAW

protection: Hełm wz. 2005 aramid helmet (PASGT-like shape; high-cut HP-05 and HBT-02 being fielded); KKZ-01 plate carrier (Gryf plate carrier, older OLV / KWM-02 vests)
notes: Dimensions are for one soldier in full kit. crew = 8 is the dismount capacity of the KTO Rosomak troop compartment, not a published table of organisation.
silhouette_features: rounded PASGT-like helmet with a short brim over the ears (wz. 2005), often with a Pantera cover
bulky plate carrier with front pouches over the uniform
conventional-layout rifle with a long top rail and a polymer stock (Grot C)
one soldier with a shoulder-fired tube: RPG-7 with its conical warhead, or the longer Carl Gustaf
wz. 93 Pantera woodland camouflage on uniform and helmet cover
camo_note: wz. 93 Pantera woodland (olive base, dark green, brown, black; soft shapes). Being replaced by K-03 Ryś from 2027 (about 220,000 sets by 2029).
